name: First Core Pack Cycle
goal: Find one scoring outlet and one midfield connector before spending rerolls aggressively.
coinRule: Use codes first, then open only enough packs to replace clear D-tier fillers.
risk: Overspending early leaves no coins for the next update or pack cost jump.

name: Weakest Line Upgrade
goal: Pick the line with the lowest real match impact: attack, midfield, defense, or keeper.
coinRule: Spend pack coins only when the new card can solve that line; otherwise save rerolls.
risk: Chasing a famous card while ignoring your weakest line creates unbalanced teams.

name: Nation and Year Alignment
goal: Use team and year rerolls to improve fit after your main card roles are stable.
coinRule: Do not burn year rerolls on filler cards; spend them on S/A-tier keepers.
risk: Perfect synergy on weak cards is worse than strong cards with acceptable fit.

name: Finals Bankroll
goal: Enter tough cups with enough rerolls left to fix one unlucky draft slot.
coinRule: Keep a small reserve rather than spending every code reward immediately.
risk: A zero-reserve squad can get stuck with a bad year or nation before finals.
